report:
Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt'; calibration started (Bahn 1 speed 60). After the 20 s wait the dialog still showed 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' with 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt gefahren … bitte warten.' Only about 40 s after the click did it change to 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 2' with the Bahn 2 confirm button.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: First setup asks for the first train
Expected: A popup or dialog asks the user to place the first train ('Bahn 1') on the calibration point and offers a button to confirm this
Observed failure: Opened the app and read the page without clicking. No popup or dialog appeared; the page loaded directly into the normal main view (track sketch, Control Panel with Bahn 1/Bahn 2, Start). No request to place Bahn 1 and no confirm button.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: First setup shows the switch hint
Expected: The page shows a hint that the user should check whether the switches are set correctly
Observed failure: Opened the app, read the snapshot (also after 3 s). No hint, message or dialog about checking the switches; only the track sketch, Control Panel and reset button.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Controls are locked until the first setup is completed
Expected: The Start button is disabled or cannot be reached, no stop can be added, and the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt'
Observed failure: No calibration dialog appeared. Start was enabled and clickable (no visible effect, badge stayed 'Gestoppt', 2 console errors). 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' was enabled and clickable; no stop was added, 2 more console errors. Controls were not visibly locked.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Opened the app; no calibration dialog appeared (also after waiting 3 s). No button to confirm the first train, so step 2 could not be done.
Steps completed before failure: 1

Feature: A second frontend shows the current setup step
Expected: The second tab directly shows the current step, i.e. the request to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point, not the request for the first train
Observed failure: Neither the first nor the second tab showed a calibration dialog; both showed the normal operating view. No request to place Bahn 2 (or Bahn 1).
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled
Observed failure: Opened two tabs; neither showed a calibration dialog or a confirm button for the second train (also after waiting 5 s). Step 3 could not be carried out; both tabs already showed the normal Control Panel with Start enabled, not as a result of completing the setup.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Opened the app; dialog 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' appeared. Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt'; Bahn 1 appeared on the track and Weiche 2 changed to 'abzweigend'. After waiting 20 s the new snapshot still showed the 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' dialog with 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt gefahren … bitte warten.' No request to place Bahn 2.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt'; calibration started (speed 0 -> 60, Bahn 1 marker shown). After waiting 20 s the new snapshot still showed 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' with 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt gefahren … bitte warten.' No request to place Bahn 2.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled
Observed failure: In the second tab clicked 'Bahn 2 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' and waited 20 s; the second tab still showed the dialog with 'Bahn 2 wird kalibriert … bitte warten.' and Start / 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' disabled (Bahn 2 appeared on the sketch). The first tab (not reloaded) was correct: dialog gone, Start enabled. The confirming tab did not leave its waiting state within 20 s.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled
Observed failure: In the second tab clicked 'Bahn 2 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt', waited 20 s and took a new snapshot: the second tab still showed 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 2' with 'Bahn 2 wird kalibriert … bitte warten.' and Start disabled. The first tab (not reloaded) was correct: no dialog, Bahn 2 on the track, Start / 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' / 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' enabled. A few seconds later the second tab's dialog was also gone. The confirming tab updated later than the other tab.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt', waited 20 s and took a snapshot: the dialog still showed 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' with 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt gefahren … bitte warten.' An extra snapshot ~5-7 s later showed 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 2' with the Bahn 2 confirm button; the switch happens but later than the 20 s of the test.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled
Observed failure: In the second tab clicked 'Bahn 2 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' and waited 20 s: the dialog was gone and 'Alle Bahnen sind kalibriert...' was shown, Bahn 2 appeared on the track, but Start, 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' were still disabled in that tab. The first tab (not reloaded) was correct: dialog gone, Start and the other buttons enabled.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' and waited 20 s. The new snapshot showed calibration had started (Bahn 1 on the track sketch, 'Geschwindigkeit: 60'), but the dialog was still 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' with 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt gefahren … bitte warten.' No request to place Bahn 2.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: After clicking 'Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' (first clicks failed due to stale refs from re-rendering), the dialog showed 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert ... bitte warten.'; after waiting 20 s the new snapshot still showed 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' with the same waiting text, 'Stand' timestamp stuck at 12:45:30, Bahn 1 speed 120, Weiche 2 abzweigend. Never advanced to Bahn 2.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
Expected: Both histories contain entries with a speed higher than the calibration speed (the train's normal speed), forward or backward; at least one train currently has a speed greater than 0; apart from the calibration speed, each train uses only one non-zero speed value
Observed failure: After Start and 15 s wait the app showed 'In Fahrt' and Bahn 2 'Geschwindigkeit: 110'; ~2 s later the mock console showed 'Speed (0-255)' = 0 for both Bahn 1 and Bahn 2, so no train currently had speed > 0. Bahn 2's latest history ended '... → 60 forward → 0 forward', Bahn 1's '... → 120 forward → 0 forward'. Other conditions met (Bahn 1 only 120, Bahn 2 only 110 besides 60).
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Switches are set while driving
Expected: After Start, new switch changes have been added to the history of 'Weichen', i.e. the app has set switches via the Switch Server while the trains were driving
Observed failure: Before Start the 'Weichen' history held 55 entries (applied: 55). While driving, the sketch showed switches changing and the counter rose to applied: 91, but reading 'Applied switch changes (oldest first)' again in step 14 the column appeared empty; final positions matched those before Start.
Steps completed before failure: 13

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: Screenshots at ~0, 4, 30, 60, 90 s after Start all showed Bahn 1 in the calibration area between Weiche 2 and the Kalibrierpunkt, mostly labelled 'Kalibrierung', once '→ Haltestelle 1'; Bahn 1 was never seen at stop A or B. Bahn 2 crept toward Haltestelle 4 labelled '→ Haltestelle 2'.
Steps completed before failure: 12

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: After Start: t≈0s Bahn 1 near Weiche 1 labelled 'Kalibrierung'; t≈25s at the Kalibrierpunkt; t≈50s on the upper-left curve still 'Kalibrierung'; t≈60s at Haltestelle 2 (B) 'Halt: Haltestelle 2'. Bahn 1 was never seen at stop A; the A → B → A sequence was not observed (action budget ran out before steps 12-13).
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: Right after Start Bahn 1 was at A ('Halt: Haltestelle 1'); ~7 s later near Haltestelle 2 labelled '→ Haltestelle 2'; ~16 s and ~44 s after Start on the top section labelled 'Kalibrierung'. Bahn 1 was never seen stopped at B and not seen back at A before the action budget ran out (steps 11-13 not done).
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: Bahn 1 was seen 'Halt: Haltestelle 1' (A), then '→ Haltestelle 2', ~30 s after Start again 'Halt: Haltestelle 1', later 'Kalibrierung' and '→ Haltestelle 1'; it was never caught standing at B, so the A → B → A sequence was not fully confirmed (sampling cut short by action budget).
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled
Observed failure: Opened the app in two tabs, both showing 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 2'. In the second tab clicked 'Bahn 2 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt', waited 20 seconds and took a fresh snapshot: the second tab still showed the calibration dialog with 'Bahn 2 wird kalibriert … bitte warten.' and Start / 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' disabled. The first tab (not reloaded) had no dialog and Start, 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' were enabled.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: Set Bahn 1 to A=Haltestelle 1, B=Haltestelle 2, Bahn 2 the same, clicked Start. At ~0 s, ~30 s and ~60 s Bahn 1 was labelled 'Kalibrierung' and moving around the loop (near Weiche 1, then next to Haltestelle 1, then near Weiche 1 again), never shown halted at A or B, so the A -> B -> A cycle was not observed. A final wait for 'Halt: Haltestelle 1' (~80 s) could not be attributed to Bahn 1. Action budget ran out before steps 12-13.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Opened the app, dialog 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1'. Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt', waited 20 seconds and took a new snapshot: the dialog was still 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' with 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt gefahren … bitte warten.' and did not ask for Bahn 2. Bahn 1 had started (speed 120, shown on the track, Weiche 3 'abzweigend'). The browser console showed 2 errors after the click.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: The 24-action budget ran out after step 10 (some actions lost to stale element references because the page re-renders constantly while trains run), so the third and fourth screenshots were not taken. In the two screenshots taken (right after Start and ~20 s later) the trains were on different sections and did not overlap; Bahn 1 made a calibration detour, so the passing moment was not clearly captured.
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Opened the app, the dialog 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' was shown; clicked 'Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt', waited 20 seconds and took a new snapshot: the dialog still was 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' with 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt gefahren … bitte warten.'; Bahn 1 showed 'Geschwindigkeit: 60'. The dialog did not ask to place Bahn 2.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: Set A=Haltestelle 1, B=Haltestelle 2 for both trains, clicked Start. Right after Start Bahn 1 was shown heading to the calibration point ('→ Kalibrierpunkt'); after 25 s it was shown stopped at B ('Halt: Haltestelle 2'). Bahn 1 was never shown at stop A; the action budget ran out before steps 11-13, so it could not be checked whether Bahn 1 returns to A.
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt'; calibration started (Bahn 1 speed 60, shown on the sketch). The snapshot 20 seconds later still showed 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 1' with 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt gefahren … bitte warten.'. Only about 35 seconds after the click did the dialog switch to 'Kalibrierung: Bahn 2' with the button 'Bahn 2 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' - not within the 20 seconds of the test.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Switch server becomes reachable again
Expected: The mock console shows at least 1 connected client for 'Weichen'; in the app the switches are no longer red and there is no error message about 'Weichen'
Observed failure: After 'Take Weichen offline' the app showed the error alert and 'keine Verbindung' for all switches. After 'Bring Weichen online' and a 15 s wait, the mock console showed 'Weichen' Online but 'Connected clients' 0 (expected >= 1). After opening the app URL again the error alert was gone and the switches were shown neutral (not red), 'Stellung gerade'. The app side is met, the connected-client count was not.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: A=Haltestelle 1, B=Haltestelle 2 for both trains, Start clicked. t=0 Bahn 1 'Halt: Haltestelle 1' (A); t=25s on the lower branch 'Haltestelle 2 → Haltestelle 1' (B itself not seen); t=50s 'Haltestelle 2 → Kalibrierpunkt'; t=75s 'Kalibrierung'; t=100s 'Halt: Haltestelle 2' (B). A was seen first and B later, but A was not seen again; the action budget was used up.
Steps completed before failure: 13

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: Steps 1-8 worked (Stop, reset, Bahn 1 A=Haltestelle 1/B=Haltestelle 2, Bahn 2 B then A, Start). The first track screenshot was taken right after Start: Bahn 2 at Haltestelle 2 ('Halt: Haltestelle 2'), Bahn 1 on the lower branch near Weiche 2 heading to the Kalibrierpunkt - no overlap. The action budget was then used up (one snapshot wasted on a stale ref), so the screenshots at 8/16/24/32 s were not taken; passing/evading was not observed.
Steps completed before failure: 8

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: Steps 1-8 completed. Two track-graphic screenshots were taken (about 0 s and 12 s after Start): markers on different sections, no overlap. The 24-action budget was then exhausted, so screenshots for steps 10-12 were not taken; the trains were never observed meeting, so waiting/evading could not be confirmed.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Switch server becomes reachable again
Expected: The mock console shows at least 1 connected client for 'Weichen'; in the app the switches are no longer red and there is no error message about 'Weichen'
Observed failure: After 'Bring Weichen online' and 15 s, the console showed Weichen Online but 'Connected clients' was 0. After reopening the app the error message was gone and the switches were neutral (not red).
Steps completed before failure: 10
